verdict.rationale: The only memory spec in the evidence is capacity, given at system level: the DGX B200 has 8 x B200 GPUs providing 1,440 GB total GPU memory, which implies roughly 180 GB per GPU but never states it for the part itself. The 14.4 TB/s figure is NVLink switch interconnect bandwidth, not memory bandwidth, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: per-GPU capacity stated directly for the B200 part, memory type (e.g. HBM generation), memory bus width, memory bandwidth, and independent corroboration of any memory spec.
